{{Top|leg}}
'''Big Snarl''' was a large ventilation shaft located near [[Monument Plaza/Legends|Monument Plaza]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was designed to pull hot air from the lower levels of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] massive [[City/Legends|city]] and disperse it throughout the upper levels. However, it was also used as a traffic interchange for many [[Skylane/Legends|skylanes]]. The center of the Big Snarl was restricted because of its strong air currents.
